target: UK owner-drivers and small courier/freight operators in one selected region/corridor who actively seek subcontract or return loads
where: One UK region/corridor to be selected after interviews; do not generalise nationally

behaviours.name: Actively searching
behaviours.how: Checks load boards or messaging groups several times a day

behaviours.name: Route/backload optimiser
behaviours.how: Looks for jobs that fit an existing route or reduce empty miles

behaviours.name: Incumbent loyalist
behaviours.how: Keeps a paid board if the job volume is dependable

behaviours.name: Price-sensitive tester
behaviours.how: Tries free or low-cost services and cancels quickly if value is unclear

behaviours.name: Relationship-led
behaviours.how: Gets most work from known brokers, local firms and referrals

objections: Will there be enough real jobs in my area and for my vehicle?
Why pay before I know the platform produces work?
Are posters and job details verified?
Can I see payment terms and avoid time-wasting or fake listings?
How is this better than the load boards or WhatsApp groups I already use?
Will it work on my phone while I am on the road?
Can I cancel without being locked into a long contract?
Does this platform serve my routes and vehicle type, not just another market?
habits: Uses a phone between jobs and needs low-friction browsing
Evaluates the platform by relevant job availability and the quality of posters
Needs to consider fuel, empty miles, time, vehicle capacity and payment terms before bidding
May use several work-finding channels in parallel
